mission.title: Cover All Your Bases
mission.description: Defend the Merovingian's programs and bases from Zion and Machine attackers.

phase.briefing:
Well, {player}, it would appear that your services are needed. Time to get off your lazy...
Good. Now proceed to the location I've pointed out. Some of the Merovingian's loyal programs are under attack.

enter.say: I'm reading plenty of activity in here.

done.say: The attackers are taken care of; you can get out of there now.

phase.briefing:
Well, it would have been nicer if you had saved those other programs. No matter.
It seems our assets are coming under rather extensive attack. Go to the next location, and destroy the foolish Zion invaders.

enter.say: This is the spot, and plenty of bad guys. Have at it!

objective.text: Kill all of the Zion invaders

talk.say: You have to help me... I must get to the... the computer... this disk...

done.say: Sounds like Rabbit could use some help!

talk.say: There... that will do... now take this! The Merovingian must get this data...

done.say: Get that disk to a hardline and I'll take a look at it.

objective.text: Upload the disk at a hardline

phase.briefing:
Well, that data is quite interesting. It would seem that... What!?
It never rains but it pours, {player}... apparently the toasters felt left out. Now they're assaulting one of our bases. Get over there and get things under control!

enter.say: From the signals, it looks like the fighting here has almost died down. Keep your eyes open...

done.say: That's it... looks like this place is pretty cleaned out.

mission.finish:
Next time, see if you can get there a little quicker, okay? Would that be too hard for you?
Bah... I'll contact you when I see fit.
